title: Hearts & Soles
description:
Built on Craft. Driving Legacy Forward.

Join Dayton and East Van makers in building the next chapter of a legendary story.

On April 23, a fire from a neighbouring restaurant swept through our building — destroying the roof, gutting the second floor, and damaging everything below. Makers, musicians, and small businesses who called Dayton home lost studios, tools, and work.

But Dayton has always been about resilience. We’re rebuilding not just a factory, but a living piece of East Van history. 


Be Part of the Story

  • Pick up a Hearts & Soles Package — lock in up to 50% off future purchases. Every dollar today is worth twice as much in future Dayton gear — and helps carry the story forward.
  • [OR: Pick up a Hearts & Soles Package and lock in up to 50% off future boots, jackets, and gear. Every dollar today rebuilds the factory — and doubles in value when you come back for the gear we’re known for.]
  • Grab a limited collection Dayton Tee — wear it proudly as part of this living East Van legacy. 

 

Where It Goes

  • Rebuilding the Dayton Factory
    Your purchase brings this heritage space back to life — helping cover renovation, permits, and the work needed to make the Hastings Factory hum again.
  • Backing Artists & Makers
    Independent creators lost their studios and tools. Hearts & Soles helps them restart, create, and keep shaping the East Van community we’re all part of.

title: Ironworker Boots
description: <meta charset="utf-8">It is not uncommon for ironworkers to work 10 to 12 hours in a single day on their feet, erecting steel frameworks and lifting heavy beams and columns into place. Due to this, they need work boots that are both comfortable and supportive, so they prefer wedge work boots. The wide, flat bottom of the wedge boot helps to distribute the ironworker's weight evenly, preventing them from slipping or losing their balance while being comfortable at the same time.

title: Logging Boots
description: Decades ago, "logging boots" specifically meant leather work boots with caulked soles for logging. Today, it could mean that (loggers still wear them) but also means a type of work boot with a tall non-Western heel and usually a lug-type sole

title: Ready to Wear Black Beauties
description:
Our Black Beauty boots made us infamous. Originally designed as rugged ranch boots, they were adopted by several Motorcycle Clubs across North America. They are known for their iconic look, exceptional durability and unbeatable comfort. 

With a rich history tied to both function and undeniable edge, they feature premium leather, Goodyear welt construction, a steel shank, and a legacy that spans generations. Our ready-to-wear Black Beauties are built by hand to the highest quality by bootmakers in a small family-run factory in Léon, Mexico, following our standards for material and craftsmanship.

Included in your Order:

  • 5-6 oz full grain upper leather for fit and durability
  • Goodyear welted construction for superior support, weather resistance, durability and easy resoling
  • Leather lining, insole and heel counter stiffeners for fit and comfort
  • Full length 1/4 inch cork fill for cushioning
  • Steel shank for long lasting support
  • Free Shipping to you.
  • 30 day money back guarantee*
  • Sizing Exchanges*
  • ”til Death do us Part” warranty

The Beauty is made on our 8223 western last in E and EEE widths.

  • We pay for shipping to you on the initial order.  You pay all shipping cost for returns and or exchanges.
  • ** we refuse to use leatherboard, cardboard, plastic, fabric/synthetic liners or foam or gel fillers.

title: Vintage
description: These vintage Dayton boots aren’t just footwear—they’re history you can walk in. Built in the era when craftsmanship meant toughness and style had edge, these 1990s originals carry the legacy of the West Coast’s motorcycle and workwear culture. Rugged, functional, and famously durable - whether you’re chasing that classic bad-boy swagger or just appreciate a boot that’s built to last - these vintage Daytons bring serious attitude and serious soles.
